_meta.purpose: Cifra multi-instrumento de Guaranteed (Eddie Vedder, Into The Wild 2007). Estrutura: instruments contem diagramas de acordes por instrumento (violao 6 cordas, ukulele 4 cordas, piano notas); content eh o texto ChordPro compartilhado entre os 3.
_meta.source: Ultimate Guitar (texto da cifra) + Claude web (tabela de subtons pros 3 instrumentos)

title: Guaranteed
content:
{section: Intro}
[G] [Bm] [G7] [C/E]
[C] [G] [D]

{section: Verso 1}
[G]                    [Bm]
On bended knee is no way to be free
[G7]                         [C/E]
Lifting up an empty cup, I ask silently
[C]                          [G]
All my destinations will accept the one that's me
   [D]
So I can breathe

{section: Verso 2}
[G]                          [Bm]
Circles they grow and they swallow people whole
[G7]                                     [C/E]
Half their lives they say goodnight to wives they'll never know
  [C]                             [G]
A mind full of questions, and a teacher in my soul
    [D]
And so it goes

{section: Verso 3}
[G]                    [Bm]
Don't come closer or I'll have to go
[G7]                          [C/E]
Holding me like gravity are places that pull
[C]                            [G]
If ever there was someone to keep me at home
   [D]
It would be you

{section: Verso 4}
[G]                          [Bm]
Everyone I come across, in cages they bought
     [G7]                                    [C/E]
They think of me and my wandering, but I'm never what they thought
     [C]                           [G]
I've got my indignation, but I'm pure in all my thoughts
[D]
I'm alive
[G]                       [Bm]
Wind in my hair, I feel part of everywhere
[G7]                       [C/E]
Underneath my being is a road that disappeared
[C]                                       [G]
Late at night I hear the trees, they're singing with the dead
[D]
Overhead

{section: Verso 5}
[G]                   [Bm]
Leave it to me as I find away to be
   [G7]                       [C/E]
Consider me a satellite, forever orbiting
[C]                                   [G]
I knew all the rules, but the rules did not know me
 [D]
Guaranteed

{section: Outro}
[G]     [Bm]
Hmm.. mm..
[G7]                     [C/E]
  Hmm.. mm.. mm.. mm.. mm
[C]               [G]
Hmm.. mm.. mm.. mm.. mm
[D]
Hmm..
